component.name: ApiTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "fetch" end sub
sub onUrlChange() m.top.control = "run" end sub
sub fetch() url = m.top.url if url = "" then return
http = CreateObject("roUrlTransfer") http.SetUrl(url) http.SetCertificatesFile("common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt") http.InitClientCertificates() http.AddHeader("Accept", "application/json") http.AddHeader("User-Agent", "MasterChief-Roku/1.0")
resp = http.GetToString() code = http.GetResponseCode()
if code >= 200 and code < 300 parsed = ParseJSON(resp) if parsed <> invalid ' RSG assocarray fields cannot hold roArray directly; ' wrap arrays so the field assignment always succeeds. if type(parsed) = "roArray" m.top.result = {_arr: parsed, _isArray: true} else m.top.result = parsed end if else ' Try XML fallback (some Xtream Codes servers return XML) xmlResult = parseXmlResponse(resp) if xmlResult <> invalid m.top.result = {_arr: xmlResult, _isArray: true} else m.top.result = {error: "Parse failed", raw: Left(resp, 300)} end if end if else m.top.result = {error: "HTTP " + str(code)} end if end sub
' Parse XML response into an array of assoc arrays. ' Handles both attribute-style and child-element-style Xtream Codes XML. function parseXmlResponse(s as String) as Object xml = CreateObject("roXMLElement") if not xml.Parse(s) then return invalid children = xml.GetChildElements() if children = invalid then return invalid
result = [] for each child in children item = {}
' attributes (e.g. <category category_id="1" category_name="News"/>) attrs = child.GetAttributes() if attrs <> invalid keys = attrs.Keys() for each k in keys item[k] = attrs[k] end for end if
' child element text (e.g. <category><category_id>1</category_id></category>) grandChildren = child.GetChildElements() if grandChildren <> invalid for each gc in grandChildren item[gc.GetName()] = gc.GetText() end for end if
result.push(item) end for
if result.count() = 0 then return invalid return result end function
